name: Progress
description: Radix Progress: a track with an indicator translated by value. Determinate only in practice.
intent: Show how much of a known quantity of work is done.

props.name: value
props.hint: Accepted by this component and passed to the underlying primitive. Named in the component signature, so it is part of this surface.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

requiredAttributes: aria-label or aria-labelledby naming what is progressing
notes: Radix sets aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax.
Label it — "Progress" alone does not say progress of what.
Show the percentage in text too. The bar alone is hard to read precisely and invisible to some users.
Announce completion in a live region; the bar reaching 100% is not itself announced.

usage: Anything where the total is known
doNotUse: Unknown duration — a progress bar that sits at an arbitrary percentage is a lie
As a slider — this is read-only; use ui:slider for input

agentRules: Show the numeric value in text alongside.
Use a spinner for unknown duration, not a fake percentage.

related.note: Agentic work with blocked and escalated states

gaps.reason: No Figma file, node, or Code Connect mapping in the spec or manifest.
No variants declared in manifest, source unions, or spec table.
